dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perhaps we met in a dream?

dialogues.speaker: "Bellringer"
dialogues.text: Haha, what an interesting way to put it! It seems you, too, have talent as an author.

dialogues.speaker: "Bellringer"
dialogues.text: Still, I do indeed believe that I met someone who looks much like you in a dream, which was why I thought you looked familiar...

dialogues.speaker: "Bellringer"
dialogues.text: #The person I met in my dream was an incredible adventurer indeed. In fact, I'm going to use {M#him}{F#her} as the protagonist in my new book!
